Write the chemical formulae of washing soda and baking soda. What are their uses?
Washing soda: Na2C03.10H20 It is used for washing clothes.
Baking soda: NaHC03 It is used for making cakes, biscuits etc. in baking industry. 057 Q.No.1 What happens vålen a piece of sodium is dropped into water?
